description: Two child machines of one state, `left` (r1.1) and `right` (r1.2). Go sends Poke to `left` alone, and its Poked is taken by `on left.Poked`, not `on right.Poked`. Next makes `left` quit; its `done` has no target and sends Poke to `right`, which is still running. `right`'s Poked leaves the state, which cancels `right`.
